mapper.select: select user_id userId, username, nick_name name, email, created_at from users
select user_id userId,username,`password`, nick_name name, created_at from users WHERE nick_name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%') AND email = #{email}
select user_id userId,username,`password`, nick_name name, created_at from users WHERE nick_name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%') AND email = #{email}
select user_id userId,username, nick_name nickName, email from users
SELECT t1.user_id AS userId, t1.nick_name AS nickName, t2.gender, t2.height_cm AS heightCm FROM users AS t1 LEFT JOIN user_profiles AS t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id

SELECT u.user_id userId,u.nick_name nickName,AVG(sd.steps) avgSteps FROM users u LEFT JOIN health_data hd ON u.user_id = hd.user_id LEFT JOIN step_data sd ON hd.record_id = sd.record_id WHERE hd.data_type = 'STEPS' AND YEAR(hd.created_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(hd.created_at) = #{month} GROUP BY u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, hd.record_id, hd.created_at, sd.steps, sd.calories, sd.distance_m FROM users u LEFT JOIN health_data hd ON u.user_id = hd.user_id AND hd.data_type = 'STEPS' LEFT JOIN step_data sd ON sd.record_id = hd.record_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into users (user_id, username, password, email, nick_name, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{name}, now())
mapper.update:
